subject: Targeted log preservation — Veridian audit request
messages:
From: Veridian Therapeutics <security@veridian.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: preserve tenant debug/session logs for upcoming external audit

Hi Avery,

We're scheduled for an external control audit with CyberAssure the week of Oct 6. Our auditor has asked that certain debug/session logs from our Redwood tenant (tenant_id: VER-7782) be preserved for a 90-day window for forensic sampling that overlaps their review period. Our default retention understanding is 30 days for ephemeral debug traces and 90 days for audit events; the auditor is specifically asking for: 

- All session-level debug traces (trace IDs, timestamps, minimal payload metadata) for the window 2025-09-15 through 2025-10-15.
- Retain these traces in exportable CSV/JSON format and provide MD5 checksums for integrity sampling.

Can Redwood accept a customer-scoped temporary extension for this tenant? If so, please confirm what evidence you can provide (CAIQ/SIG slices, sample export, attestation letter) and an estimated timeline — the auditor needs confirmation by 09/20 to include it in their artifact plan.

I've attached a short request form. Thanks,

--
Lena Ortiz
Head of Security Operations
Veridian Therapeutics
security@veridian.com
Attachment: veridian_request_form.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: preserve tenant debug/session logs for upcoming external audit

Folks — forwarding Veridian's ask. Short summary and proposed path below.

Summary: Veridian (VER-7782) requests temporary retention extension for session/debug traces from 2025-09-15 through 2025-10-15 (effectively 90-day preservation for that slice) for an external audit. They need exportable files and integrity checks. They need confirmation by EOD 09/20.

Questions / risks: 
- Compliance: do we have a mechanism for tenant-scoped retention changes without altering platform-wide TTLs?
- Legal/contract: is this a one-off addendum or covered by existing SOC/SLA?
- Data minimization / PII exposure: can we redact payloads or provide metadata-only exports?

Proposed approach (draft):
1) Security confirms a compensating-control attestation: we can provide audited export + MD5 checksums + redacted sample for SOC2/SIG evidence.
2) Product/Infra produce an export package for the requested window (sample run + instructions) within 4 business days.
3) Sales/Legal draft a provisional retention addendum (60-day interim we can accept quickly) and route to Veridian for signature; full 90-day approval after legal review.

Irene - can you confirm whether we can provide a CAIQ-slice & sample export without full policy change? Marissa/Ben - if this is accepted, I'll coordinate the addendum and timeline.

Thanks,
Avery
--
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: preserve tenant debug/session logs for upcoming external audit

Avery / team,

We can support a customer-scoped preservation request with the following caveats and deliverables: 

Caveats:
- This will be implemented as a tenant-scoped export & short-term retention hold rather than a global TTL change. We avoid changing platform defaults.
- Exports will be redacted by default to remove user-uploaded payloads; we can include metadata fields (trace_id, timestamp, event_type, route) and a limited set of non-PII context. If Veridian requires payloads, we'll need legal approval and documented justification.
- For integrity, Infra can produce MD5 checksums for each exported file.

Deliverables (we can produce within 4 business days after approval):
- CAIQ slice (redacted) showing applicable controls for log preservation (attachment: caiaq-redacted.pdf).
- Sample export (rwd_sample-log-export.csv) covering a 48-hour slice for their review.
- Attestation email describing the temporary preservation process and timelines.

Operational steps: create JIRA-SEC-4987 to track the export job and legal signoff. I suggest a provisional 60-day retention approval that we can extend to 90 days post-legal/contract addendum. Legal will need to sign off on any full payload retention.

I'll coordinate with Infra to prepare the sample export.

Irene Choi
Sr. Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Veridian Therapeutics <security@veridian.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: preserve tenant debug/session logs for upcoming external audit

Hi Lena,

Thanks for the request and for the form — we can support a targeted preservation for VER-7782. To keep things moving for your auditor, here's what we can commit to immediately and what requires a short approval loop: 

What we can do now (no contractual change required):
- Produce a redacted export (metadata only) for 2025-09-15 -> 2025-10-15 and provide MD5 checksums. We will deliver a 48-hour sample export by 2025-09-22 for your auditor to validate.
- Provide a redacted CAIQ slice and an attestation email describing the preservation scope and controls. Drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1a2b3cRetentionEvidence

What requires signoff (legal/addendum):
- If you need payload-level traces (full debug payloads), Legal must approve and we'll need a signed addendum. Our proposed interim path is a provisional 60-day retention addendum while Legal reviews for a 90-day allowance.

Attached is a provisional addendum draft (provisional-retention-addendum-v1.docx). If you're agreeable, signatories and DocuSign routing will get that formalized and we can extend the retention window to 90 days upon completion.

Next steps: 
1) Veridian confirms whether redacted metadata exports are sufficient for CyberAssure.
2) If yes, we generate the 48-hour sample by 09/22 and deliver CAIQ slice & attestation.
3) If payloads required, confirm and we'll route the addendum through DocuSign (we can provisionally accept 60 days while legal processes).

Thanks — looping in Irene and Marissa to help deliver the artifacts.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: provisional-retention-addendum-v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Veridian Therapeutics <security@veridian.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@cyberassure.com
Date: 2025-09-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: preserve tenant debug/session logs for upcoming external audit

Avery — thanks for the quick turnaround and detail. CyberAssure confirms that a redacted metadata export + checksums + CAIQ slice will be sufficient for initial artifact review. They may request a payload sample as a follow-up, but the redacted set should cover our primary audit points.

Please proceed with the 48-hour sample export by 09/22. We'll also sign the provisional 60-day addendum via DocuSign; legal@veridian.com will be the signer. Please send the DocuSign link when ready.

Appreciate the help — lean on us if you need additional attestation formatting for your SOC2 pack.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Security Operations
Veridian Therapeutics
Attachment: none
